bullets.text: one slot in the vending machine has been sold out for weeks. nobody restocks it. everybody still presses it.
duck still at okunoin, overcast, nineteen degrees. today's line is about idiots and sages breaking man-made laws.
reading the manual for a thing i already assembled wrong. the manual agrees with me on page four.
steady. like a chair that stopped wobbling once someone sat down properly.
a rule nobody has ever broken is not yet a rule.
